observations: Photo 0: A black rectangular solar power bank held in hand, with a solar panel on the front and four blue LED indicators lit. A turquoise side panel is visible. Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI G-MAN O' is overlaid.
Photo 1: The back of the same device, showing a flat surface and two circular lights (likely flashlights) at the bottom. Watermark present.
Photo 2: Side view with the two flashlights turned on, emitting bright white light. The turquoise side panel is visible. Watermark present.

claims.claim: Fairly used solar power bank is excellent working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show the LEDs and flashlights are lit, indicating power, but there is no proof of charging capability or battery health. No model or brand is visible to verify specifications.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or not holding charge, despite LEDs being lit.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the power bank charging a phone or other device, or a capacity test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with very low capacity

risks.risk: Solar panel may be non-functional or inefficient.
risks.proof: Video showing the solar panel charging the device under sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-solar or with reduced value

risks.risk: Internal damage or wear not visible in photos, such as cracked circuitry or loose connections.
risks.proof: Close-up of ports and internal components if opened, or a test video.

proof_requests: Video showing the power bank charging a phone or device.
Video of the solar panel charging the device under sunlight.
Close-up of the ports and any labels or model numbers.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a solar power bank, but critical claims about its working condition and functionality cannot be verified from the photos alone. The LEDs and flashlights being lit do not confirm charging capability or battery health. Proof of charging and solar function is needed before pricing.
